llm.summary: This skill is a disclosed mkts.io market-data integration with sensitive account actions gated by explicit confirmation requirements.

dimensions.detail: Network access to https://mkts.io/api/v1 and optional local image output are proportionate to the financial data and portfolio-card features described.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The inspected artifact is a single non-executable markdown skill requiring only curl, with an optional MKTS_API_KEY environment variable.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions repeatedly require exact payload display, immediate user confirmation for POST/PATCH/DELETE, ID resolution before deletion, API-key secrecy, and minimization of private content.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Portfolio holdings, journal entries, watchlists, registration details, and generated API credentials may persist in mkts.io accounts, but the skill discloses this and requires user-directed confirmation for changes.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The skill provides market data plus portfolio, journal, and watchlist workflows; account mutations and sensitive financial records are part of the stated purpose and are clearly disclosed.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable sending market queries and any chosen portfolio, journal, or watchlist data to mkts.io. Use an environment variable for MKTS_API_KEY, review every displayed mutation payload carefully, and remember deletions have no documented undo.
